name: Traveling Merchants
description: Dedicated merchant NPCs out ON THE ROUTES that travel by in-game day (world_clock) and patrol under real collision (mapOverview) - spawned at runtime, no map edits. Two merchants (a 5-route Peddler + a 2-route Trader). Wares: daily supplies, RARE WARES (the Mt. Moon fossil you didn't take + Old Amber, Moon Stone, Nugget, a rotating TM), and a daily rare POKeMON (never common species). Route mode (3/5/random) in OPTIONS.
